description: Use this to list stored requests for a webhook source, or to read one full body. Read-only; requires auth. Inputs: inbox_id (omit when this key is limited to one inbox), source_id (required), event_id (optional wsev_…; when set, returns that request including body), limit (optional, 1 to 100, default 50), cursor (optional). List is newest first and omits the body. The full body is on the single-request result. Another source is HTTP 404 webhook_source_not_found.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous list. Used when event_id is omitted.

event_id.description: Stored request id (wsev_…). Omit it to list requests.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id, username, or email. Omit it when this key is limited to one inbox.

limit.description: Page size from 1 to 100. Default 50. Used when event_id is omitted.

name: cooper_webhook_source_events

outputSchema.description: Stored webhook requests, or one full request when event_id was set.

body.description: Full stored body when one request is returned. Untrusted data.

content_type.description: Content-Type of the stored request, or null.

data.description: Stored requests, newest first, when listing.

delivery_id.description: Sender delivery id used for dedup, or null.

event_type_hint.description: X-GitHub-Event or JSON body.type, when present.

has_more.description: True when more items are waiting after this page.

headers.description: Selected request headers. Authorization, Cookie, and signature headers are omitted.

id.description: Stored request id (wsev_…) when one request is returned.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…) this object belongs to. Null when it applies to every inbox.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next call, or null. Pass it back as after or before.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

received_at.description: ISO-8601 time Cooper stored the request.

replayed_at.description: ISO-8601 time this request was replayed, or null.

verified.description: True when the signature checked out.

title: Read stored webhook requests
